name: Boba
summary: A goals and planning assistant you text or use on the web, in one-to-one or group chats, officially free with no card and no app install.
description: Boba is an AI assistant for goals, habits, plans and group coordination. You text it from your phone, add it to a group chat, or use it on the web. Nothing to download; it works in Messages and on the web. There is no /pricing path. A paid plan was not listed on the official homepage checked. The site notes that Boba can get things wrong, and that messages may be used to improve it.

pricing.details: Officially free, no card, no app to install and no sign-up. No paid plan is listed on the official homepage, and there is no /pricing path.
